issues.description: Spec defines BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR as 8. Implementation uses 9. This changes both increase path (target_fee_gas_delta // denominator) and decrease path, producing ~11% smaller base-fee adjustments per block than specified.
issues.potential_impact: Consensus failure: baseFee computed by this client will diverge from EIP-1559 reference (expected_base_fee_per_gas == block.base_fee_per_gas check) and from other clients. Blocks valid under spec will be rejected/accepted incorrectly, causing chain split. Also alters economic response to congestion.
issues.suggestion: Change DEFAULT_BASEFEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR to 8L to match spec: parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR with denominator 8.

issues.code_location: LondonFeeMarket.java: DEFAULT_BASEFEE_FLOOR = Wei.of(7L), baseFeeFloor field, satisfiesFloorTxFee()
issues.description: Spec has no 7 wei minimum base/tx fee. Reference logic allows base fee to decay toward zero: base_fee_per_gas_delta = parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR; expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas - base_fee_per_gas_delta. Implementation imposes a 7 wei floor (or ZERO if initial is zero) and a satisfiesFloorTxFee() filter requiring gas_price/max_fee >= floor.
issues.potential_impact: Consensus and liveness deviation: when spec baseFee should fall below 7 wei, this client computes/enforces a higher value and may reject valid transactions/blocks with fees <7 wei or accept a different baseFee than canonical chain, causing split. Stuck floor also breaks burn dynamics and EIP test vectors for empty-chain decay to zero.
issues.spec_reference: else: gas_used_delta = parent_gas_target - parent_gas_used; base_fee_per_gas_delta = parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR; expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas - base_fee_per_gas_delta
issues.suggestion: Remove baseFeeFloor / satisfiesFloorTxFee consensus enforcement. Allow baseFee to decrease per spec formula down to zero, with no extra minimum. If a mempool spam filter is desired, keep it strictly as local non-consensus policy, not in block validation.

issues.code_location: LondonFeeMarket.java: constructor LondonFeeMarket(..., Optional<Wei> baseFeePerGasOverride), baseFeeInitialValue, getInitialBasefee()
issues.description: Spec fixes fork-block base fee: if INITIAL_FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER == block.number: expected_base_fee_per_gas = INITIAL_BASE_FEE where INITIAL_BASE_FEE = 1000000000. Implementation allows arbitrary override via baseFeePerGasOverride.orElse(DEFAULT_BASEFEE_INITIAL_VALUE) with no validation shown that default equals 1000000000.
issues.potential_impact: If configured with non-1-gwei initial value, genesis/fork block baseFee will not match spec, causing immediate consensus divergence at London fork and invalid GASPRICE/effective_gas_price and priority_fee_per_gas calculations downstream.
issues.suggestion: Pin default to Wei.of(1000000000L) and reject or explicitly document any override as non-mainnet/test-only. Enforce that for mainnet fork block, computeBaseFee/baseFeeValidationMode returns exactly 1000000000.

summary: Core EIP-1559 base-fee formula structure (gasDelta, increase max(...,1), fork-block initial return) is present and slack coefficient 2 matches, but max-change denominator is 9 instead of 8 and a non-spec 7-wei floor plus configurable initial fee deviate from consensus. These cause baseFee divergence and chain-split risk.
